integrity: Analytic proof and an independently specified finite numerical checker supplied. Finite computation is supplementary, not an infinite proof. Bounded primary literature comparison including a full-text 2017 constructive theorem; some other full texts inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless result for cubic polynomial evaluation on two equally populated regular hexagonal circles; no uniform noise bound, nonlinear inversion algorithm, or global twelve-measurement optimality. Unindexed earlier equivalent constructions cannot be excluded.
title: Exact hexagon-pair phase retrieval for complex cubic polynomials
